nodes.label: Brand Palette (orange, teal on dark charcoal)
nodes.norm_label: brand palette (orange, teal on dark charcoal)

nodes.label: Swift CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on macos-latest with full Xcode toolchain so plain `swift test` builds and links the test bundle; scripts/test.sh is tuned for local CLT-only setups. Ignores worker/** paths.

nodes.label: Worker deploy job (wrangler deploy)
nodes.rationale: Uses cloudflare/wrangler-action with concurrency group worker-deploy; preCommand npm run sync copies schemas before deploy.

nodes.label: Worker CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggered only by worker/**, schema/** changes; check job (npm ci, sync, typecheck) gates deploy job which only runs on main pushes.

nodes.label: ProjectModel (in-memory mirror with FSEvents)
nodes.rationale: Writes each change immediately and watches folder via FSEvents to apply external changes live, as undoable edits.

nodes.label: ProjectStore (VibeDeckCore, stateless disk IO)
nodes.rationale: Stateless: every operation reads/writes disk atomically with tolerant JSON for hand-edited files.

nodes.label: Build scripts (build-app.sh, env.sh, test.sh)
nodes.rationale: Without Xcode, SDK 27 cannot compile SwiftUI (@State macro needs SwiftUIMacros plugin), so env.sh falls back to SDK 26.x and tests run via scripts/test.sh.

nodes.label: Cloud session (start_cloud_session / cloud_check)
nodes.rationale: Cloud only sees GitHub, so local default branch must equal origin before creating a session; dirty tree requires allow_dirty.

nodes.label: JSON schemas served at vibedeck-schema workers.dev /v1
nodes.norm_label: json schemas served at vibedeck-schema workers.dev /v1

nodes.label: Claude Code page in app (claude -p stream-json)
nodes.norm_label: claude code page in app (claude -p stream-json)
nodes.rationale: Streams responses, asks permission before edits (allow/session/always persisted in .claude/settings.local.json), mode switcher Normal/Plan/Accept edits, conversation resumes on reopen.

nodes.label: Claude Code usage limits (statusline -> claude-usage.json)
nodes.rationale: Numbers come from Claude Code statusline via `vibedeck usage record`; existing statusline chained with --then; only works with Pro/Max subscription login.

nodes.label: Cloud sessions (claude --cloud)
nodes.rationale: VibeDeck git-fetches and compares local default branch to origin because cloud only sees GitHub.

nodes.label: Terminal page (SwiftTerm login shell)
nodes.rationale: Interactive programs invoked via ! in Claude chat open here; keeps running across tabs.

nodes.label: VibeDeck AGENTS.md guide for AI agents
nodes.norm_label: vibedeck agents.md guide for ai agents
nodes.rationale: Generated by the app; tells agents to prefer CLI/MCP over hand-editing JSON and that no task is done without passing rules.

nodes.label: Authorship rule (author human|ai; never delete human items)
nodes.norm_label: authorship rule (author human|ai; never delete human items)

nodes.label: Mandatory rules check flow (rules_for -> verify -> submit_rule_check)
nodes.norm_label: mandatory rules check flow (rules_for -> verify -> submit_rule_check)
nodes.rationale: No task is complete until a rule check passes; must rules block, should rules only warn.

nodes.label: Direct editing with autosave and undo (no Save button)
nodes.norm_label: direct editing with autosave and undo (no save button)

nodes.label: Docs are context, not rules
nodes.rationale: Keep rule text short; long explanation lives in a doc referenced in details.

nodes.label: Done blocking for review items without approved check
nodes.norm_label: done blocking for review items without approved check
nodes.rationale: MCP/CLI refuse done while latest check fails or new rules exist; humans can --force in CLI; app only warns.

nodes.label: Repo-local readable storage (vibedeck.json + .vibedeck/)
nodes.rationale: Everything lives in the repo in readable files so humans and AI read and write the same source.

nodes.label: Rules as the center of VibeDeck
nodes.norm_label: rules as the center of vibedeck
nodes.rationale: Rules say what must keep holding; checks prove an agent verified them; every other concept plays a role in that machinery.

nodes.label: rules_for three-source resolution (global, path-matched, explicit topics)
nodes.norm_label: rules_for three-source resolution (global, path-matched, explicit topics)

nodes.label: Tags are organization, not scope
nodes.rationale: Only paths and item rules field decide applicable rules; tags only filter lists.
